title: God Has Already Gone Ahead of You Today | Morning Prayer for Peace and Courage
description:
Before you walk into today, God has already been there. Pray this morning prayer with us for peace, courage and a clean start, anchored in Deuteronomy 31:8, Lamentations 3:22-23, Psalm 143:8, Isaiah 41:10 and Proverbs 3:5-6.

Chapters
0:00 Good morning
0:47 He goes before you (Deuteronomy 31:8)
1:33 New mercy every morning (Lamentations 3:22-23)
2:14 Show me the way (Psalm 143:8)
3:23 Let us pray
6:32 Fear not (Isaiah 41:10)
7:47 Declaration for today
9:08 One thing to do today
9:30 Blessing

Scripture quotations: King James Version (public domain).
Narration and music: original HeroVerse productions.
